$description: Mola UI design tokens (DTCG 2025.10), generated from src/styles/tokens.css and theme.css by scripts/export-tokens.ts. Do not edit by hand.

shadow.$description: The cut (keyline), the focus rings and the one elevation, resolved per theme.

text.$description: The comfortable type scale; density modes re-scale 2xs to xl.

leading.$description: Line height, as a multiple of the font size.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing as a multiple of the font size (CSS em). DTCG dimensions are px or rem only, and tracking must scale with the type.

wdth.$description: Archivo's and Martian Mono's width axis (font-variation-settings 'wdth').

reading.$description: The prose measure, in ch (characters of the element’s own font): max-w-reading.

density.$description: Set by data-density on any element. Each mode lists every density-dependent token; comfortable is the product default.
